reviews.title: Severely buggy
reviews.text:
At first I thought this app was better than twitch but as time goes on I realize how wrong I was. First of all the developers are falling far behind on catching and fixing bugs. Cant stream to my tv at all now due to a severe bug. Constantly booting me out, nearly nonstop freezing and going completely black. It auto rewinds and reboots and I genuinely can’t watch more than 15 seconds of any stream without the app failing completely. Severe lack of customer support as well, they just run you In loops and treat you like you’re incompetent with technology like the issue is operator error when it’s clearly out of my control. 

Every time the app updates they miss bugs and then I don’t get to watch my favorite streamers. That being said, streamers are losing money on this platform for how horribly it performs. Viewers are wasting money on a platform that consistently won’t work. 

On top of all that, there is also issues on the Xbox and pc. Going to 1080p creates a severe lag that makes it unwatchable. I expect so much better. What actually separates kick vs twitch at this point? If you’re going to create a business that’s an exact copy paste of someone else’s I expect it to work better. Went from a 4 star review to a measly 1 star in the matter of just a few months.

reviews.title: 35 GB Scam of an app
reviews.text: Not only does this app have continuous glitches preventing it from doing what its advertised, the platform simply does notshow any care for its viewers and the people poiring money into it. Ive given Kick a year to show some sort of improvement and Im only seeing more glitches onntop of the continuous ones that were there when i first got it 2 years ago. Plus, I justsaw that it was using 35 GB of my local phone storage AND it costs more than the browser? Kick is still in beta after 3 years and has its glitches, but thats no excuse for the continued lack of improvement for the viewer. The kick app not only has far less functionability than the website, freezing forcing you to refresh, losing your spot in chat, even showing host notifications for a previous stream when you’re watching a whole new streamer, but you actually are paying more for this dysfunctional, scam of an app. Subscribing/gifting and purchasing anything off the app costs more, yet you get far less than if youre on PC. The app blocks people when you’re simply trying to respond to them in chat and it doesnt even have basic, functional moderator actions for the mods working to uphold streams. This app needs to be wiped and redone completely and I will not be putting anymore money into Kick until I see actions that show they care about the viewer, those funding the streamer and Kick’s service.
